dining.name: Shipwreck Reef Café
dining.summary: The waterfront café beside the flume — themed dining with outdoor seating facing the splash zone.
description: Shipwreck Reef Café anchors the waterfront's food row with hearty plates and a patio that doubles as Journey to Atlantis splash seating — an accidental entertainment the park has wisely never discouraged.
The menu runs burritos, plates and grilled items — the most substantial counter food at the park. The patio's flume-front tables are the best lunch seats in the park by any measure.
tips: Claim a flume-front table at lunch — the soak show comes free with the meal.
App ordering skips the register queue at peak.
dining.verdict: The best counter food at the park with the best patio. The splash-zone table is a theme-park dining highlight.

dining.name: Dole-Whip-style Soft Serve Cart
dining.summary: The soft-serve cart in the ride cluster — the between-coasters cooldown in a cup.
description: The soft-serve cart in the Ocean Explorer cluster serves the standard swirls and floats — the palette cleanser between Electric Eel cycles on a hot afternoon.
Nothing signature, everything correct: cold, fast, and two minutes from the next launch.
tips: The float beats the cup for queue-adjacent sipping.
Eat it before Electric Eel, not after — trust the physics.
dining.verdict: A competent soft-serve cart in the right place. The regional marine-layer afternoon makes it a ritual.
